title: SheetRule
description: Our rule record. No source token, formula string, or variable name in it.

also.description: Second/third numbers on one line: uses + caster level + save DC.

always_held.description: On a record principal only (SD-36 F1c-4, defect D7): the converter attests that EVERY character holds this record unconditionally -- a global ability the oracle grants from an object every character holds (PCGen gives every character every `STAT:` and `SAVE:` row, `PlayerCharacter.java:572-573`; the Pathfinder Strength row carries `ABILITY:Internal|AUTOMATIC|Default`, `cr__stats.lst:4`). What it changes is the BASE STATE every evaluation starts from, and nothing else: the record's variable declarations, and its contributions whose own gate is `Always`, count as held for every character ([`SheetRulePackage::is_always_held`], read by the variable fold). The record itself is not seeded into the held set -- it prints no line and folds no bonus of its own.

bonus_type.description: Stacking type for the cross-rule fold.

closure_complete.description: On a CLASS principal only (SD-36 F1c-3, defect D4; `epic-f-class-completion.md` §3.4): the converter attests the class's grant closure complete -- every rule the class line reaches through `Granter::Class` / `Granter::Rule` edges (a class-selection class's base class line included) converted with ZERO closure defects (unresolved reference, ambiguous target, grant-by-type, undefined variable, unrecognized proficiency tag, or a grant edge onto an unconverted target). Absent (false) is "not attested", never "incomplete proven": a reader may answer a known EMPTY set only when this is true.

grants.description: What holding it does to the fact set.

label.description: Display name; codex-neutral when the name is product identity.

print.description: Printed on the sheet (`false`: held silently -- a selector or helper record).

prose.description: The rule's words with typed slots, filled at evaluate time.

target.description: What sheet total this value feeds, if any.

Applies.description: The gate. Two-valued (Include / Exclude) plus `Situational`, which includes and prints its condition on the line.

BonusType.description: A stacking type. `name` is a game-rule word (`"Racial"`, `"Base"`), never a token.

oneOf.description: A fact grant that is conditional on `when` -- the PRE-gate a PCGen `AUTO:WEAPONPROF` (etc.) row carries on the individual fact, distinct from `Grant.when` (which gates whether the character may hold the whole RULE, not one fact inside it; SD-36 Epic F1-2, review finding 1). Added as a new variant, never a field on `FactGrant`, so every existing converted `{"FactGrant": ...}` row (ungated: the common case) still deserializes byte-for-byte unchanged -- the future population diff this enables stays small (`ungated_fact_grants_deserialize_unchanged`). `resolve_gated_fact_grant` is the paper-sheet-doctrine reader: the fact counts only when `when` is decidable and true from the character's own facts; otherwise its condition prints and the fact is withheld, never approximated as granted.

On a CLASS principal only: this class is a selection taken on the named base class, so every level in it IS a level in the base class (SD-36 F1c-3, defect D3). PCGen declares no `CLASS:` object for such a class -- Pathfinder Unchained's four are `CATEGORY:CLASS` abilities in the base class's `<Base> Class Selection` pool (`pu_abilities_class.lst`) -- so the character's class line is the base class's, with the selection held on it. The held-set fixpoint and `Expr::ClassLevel` read it through [`SheetRulePackage::base_class_of`]; the character's total level is unchanged.

Expr.description: Our expression form. Closed vocabulary; every variant names a fact the live character has. Evaluation is exact (rational); nothing here truncates -- the `SheetValue` boundary does, once.

The character has this natural attack (SD-36 F3c5). A PCGen `CATEGORY:Internal` helper row (`Bite`, `ce_abilities_race.lst:249`) whose whole object -- its own row, its `.MOD` rows, the size helpers it grants and their templates -- carries nothing but one natural attack's bookkeeping (`DEFINE`, `BONUS:VAR`, `BONUS:WEAPONPROF=<the attack>`, `PRE*`, `TEMPLATE`, `NATURALATTACKS`) converts as this fact on the rule that grants the helper, named by the attack its `NATURALATTACKS` entries name. A fact, never a proficiency: a natural attack grants no weapon proficiency. The printed rule's own text states the attack's damage; nothing is computed from this fact.
A class spell list holds the rule at this spell level.
A rule named by the source that resolves to no corpus record (listed in `_defects/`); evaluates Exclude.
A named fact declared by a `FactDeclare` effect on some held rule.

declared.description: Fields omitted because the corpus record declares them product identity.

term_hits.description: Fields omitted because a blacklist term appeared in the text.

Printing.description: SD-36 F6c: one printing of an object several books state, as the converter reads it.

newest.description: The reprint resolver's verdict: the newest printing when it proved the printings one object (`reprint::newest_printing`); `None` when it did not (a variant, or rows it cannot prove identical).

printings.description: Every record of this kind and slug across books, this one included, sorted.

source_date.description: This record's book's `.pcc` `SOURCEDATE:` (`YYYY-MM`); `None` when the book states none (or two), so its printings are never ordered by it.

oneOf.description: The weapon the player chose on this rule.

A conjunctive weapon selector (PCGen's `TYPE=Martial.Ranged`) whose every tag the live `WeaponTableEntry` can answer directly -- a tier (`proficiency`) AND/OR a reach (`is_melee`/`is_ranged`). SD-36 Epic F1-3 (`epic-f-class-completion.md` §3.2/§3.3): today's converter joined a conjunction into one lossy word (`"Light.Martial"`); this is the list instead. A conjunct carrying a tag the table cannot answer (e.g. `Light`, `Thrown`) is never put here -- it becomes a [`ProfRef::WeaponSet`] instead, expanded at ingest.

A named membership selector the live weapon table cannot answer generically: a weapon culture/group tag such as `Samurai` (`uc_profs_weapon.lst:100`'s `Katana.MOD TYPE:Samurai.HeavyBlade` -- membership exists only as an ADDED tag on the weapons that carry it, never its own record), or a conjunction containing an unanswerable tag (`Light.Martial`). `members` is the literal weapon name list, resolved AT INGEST from the oracle's own weapon-proficiency rows (its base row plus every `.MOD` row naming it) -- never hand-typed (SD-36 Epic F1-3, review finding 15). `label` is the selector's own tag text, kept for display; matching at read time is against `members`, never `label`.
`"DC "` + `Slot(...)` -> `"DC 15"`; truncated toward zero once per slot.
The chosen option's name(s); unmade -> the choice lane's unmade words.
`"1d6+"` with a modifier stays dice.

SD-36 F7b: dice whose NUMBER is a formula the source wrote into the words (`(min(10,CASTERLEVEL))d6`, the Fireball damage): `count` dice of `sides` sides. The sheet prints `5d6` for a caster level 5 character; with no character the catalog prints the rule's words ("1d6 per caster level (maximum 10d6)").

ProseSegment.description: Words with typed holes. Text pieces are plain English; no marker, no token.

pick_last.description: Print only the LAST segment of this family whose gate passes.

suppress_when_all_zero.description: Omit the line when every slot evaluates to 0.

Provenance.description: Where the rule came from. The only place a source path or row citation may appear.

closure_rows.description: `path:line` of every closure row read, in application order.

overlay.description: `"pfs"` when the record's own base row sits in an organized-play overlay file.

pi.description: Product-identity handling on this rule: field families omitted and why.

printing.description: SD-36 F6c: on a class record whose slug another book's class record also states, the converter's supersession reading (`decisions.md` §12) -- the one place publication order and the one-object proof exist (`codex-ingest` `sheet_rule::reprint`); the runtime package carries neither otherwise. Absent on every other record.

undeclared_in_pinned_tree.description: SD-36 F3b2b: variable names this record's formulas read that no row of the pinned oracle tree declares and that are not oracle built-in terms. The oracle evaluates each as 0, so the converter wrote `Const(0)` for it; the names are kept here so the reading is visible.

`"1d8"` + `Const(2)` -> `"1d8+2"`; `size_steps` = held die-size steps.
The list form indexed by `Size` ordinal, Fine..Colossal.
Nothing to compute; the prose IS the value.
Starfinder 1e spells: no arcane/divine/psychic split, spell levels 0 to 6.
